An all-empty table parses through `tableutil.BuildTableData` into a nil grid while `HeaderRows` stays 1, so the count goes negative and `make([]string, 0, ...)` panics with `makeslice: cap out of range`, failing the whole ingestion task. workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: knowledge-compiler retry progress messages report the base delay instead of the wait taken (since #22290)

The request flag never reached the provider: `kcChatInvoker` built `models.ChatConfig` without it, and `ChatConfig` had no JSON-mode field at all, so the shared ... workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Confluence sync fails for long UTF-8 page names — invalid byte truncation causes MySQL Error 1366
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Preserve UTF-8 when truncating synced filenames. Target files: internal/service/document/sync_document.go, internal/service/document/sync_document_test.go. Long Confluence page names can fail to sync because the shared filename formatter slices at a fixed byte offset. A split UTF-8 character leaves an invalid byte sequence in the document name, which MySQL rejects. (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/22645)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: PyFloat64 does not match Python json.dumps: 1.0 becomes 1 and 1000000.0 becomes 1e+06 in Go API responses
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(common): make PyFloat64 print floats like Python json.dumps. Target files: internal/common/number.go, internal/common/number_test.go. `common.PyFloat64` is documented to print floats the way Python's `json.dumps` does, but its `MarshalJSON` used `strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'g', -1, 64)`. Go's `'g'` drops the `.0` of whole numbers and switches to exponent form once the decimal exponent reaches 6, while Python keeps `.0` and only uses exponent form below 1e-4 and from 1e16. So `ConvertFloatsToPyFormat` (used for the `POST ... (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/22638)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: OpenSearch document engine drops the memory keyword filter and zeroes tag rerank weights (ES parity)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(opensearch): restore the Elasticsearch memory filter and rank-feature parity. workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Go knowledge compile: the dataset backlog is a TEXT column, so a backlog over ~530 documents silently drops completions
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(knowledge_compile): widen backlog columns to LONGTEXT. Target files: internal/dao/migration.go, internal/dao/migration_integration_test.go, internal/dao/migration_test.go. The knowledge compile scheduler stores pending and inflight queues as JSON in MySQL TEXT columns, which cannot hold a backlog above 65,535 bytes. Store both queues as LONGTEXT for new and existing schemas, and add migration coverage for preserving existing JSON and storing a backlog above that limit. (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/20855)
